mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Awakened Mantle Stance</titleLeft><mainText>Udyr is protected by a large shield and heals over time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Monk Training</titleLeft><mainText>Udyr's next two attacks gains Attack Speed and refund some of <spellActive>Awakened Spirit's</spellActive> cooldown.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Storm Stance</titleLeft><mainText>Udyr's first two attacks in this stance deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Awakened Stampede Stance</titleLeft><mainText>Udyr has greatly increased Move Speed and immunity to Immobilizing and Disabling effects.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Awakened Wilding Stance</titleLeft><mainText>Udyr's Attack Speed is greatly increased and his next two attacks chain lightning to deal bonus magic damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Awakened Mantle Stance</titleLeft><mainText>Udyr is protected by a large shield and heals over time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Stampede Stance</titleLeft><mainText>Udyr's first attack against each target leaps at them and Stuns them.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack against each target will Stun them. Recast: Gain even more movement speed and immunity to immobilizing effects for a couple seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Stampede Stance: Udyr gains @MoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed, decaying over @MoveSpeedDuration@ seconds. Additionally, Udyr's Attacks dash him to the target and Stun for @StunDuration@ seconds (@ICD@ second Cooldown per target).

Awaken: Grants immunity to Immobilizing and Disabling effects and an additional @MoveSpeedBonus@ Move Speed for @UnstoppableDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Udyr moves through units during the Move Speed boost, and his Attacks in this <keywordMajor>Stance</keywordMajor> can't be cancelled.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Blazing Stampede</titleLeft><mainText>Udyr has increased Move Speed and ignores unit collision.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Stunned</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been recently hit by Udyr in Stampede Stance. Subsequent attacks from Udyr will not stun them.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances and can Recast an Ability to renew it with Ultimate benefits. Additionally, after using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks gain Attack Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Awakened Spirit: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances. Udyr can Recast an Ability that is on Cooldown to gain its bonuses again with Ultimate benefits. (@UltCD@ second Cooldown).

Monk Training: After using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks within @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed and refund @UltCDReduction*100@% of Awaken's Cooldown.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Claw Stance</titleLeft><mainText>Udyr's first two attacks in this stance gain increased range and bonus damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Udyr gains attack speed and his next two attacks deal bonus physical damage. Recast: Gain even more attack speed, and the next two attacks call lightning to strike the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Claw Stance: Udyr gains @AttackSpeedBase*100@% Attack Speed and his Attacks deal @OnHitDamage@ physical damage {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} for @AttackSpeedDurationBase@ seconds. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks in this stance deal a bonus @MaxHPOnHit1@ max Health physical damage and gain @AttackRange@ range.

Awaken: Increase bonus Attack Speed to @EmpoweredTotalAS@ and max Health damage to @Q2TotalOnHitHPDamage@. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks call lightning six times, dealing a total of @EmpoweredLightningBonusMax@ max Health magic damage to isolated targets (strikes bounce to other nearby targets when possible).
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Claw Stance Max Health damage is capped at @MonsterCap@ to monsters. Each lightning strike deals <magicDamage>@EmpoweredLightningBonus@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage>  Minimum damage to minions: @LightningDamageToMinionsMin@).</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Storm Stance</titleLeft><mainText>Udyr's first two attacks in this stance deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Recast: Empower and unleash the storm, causing it to track enemies and deal additional damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Storm Stance: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm for @BuffDuration@ seconds, dealing @StormDamage@ magic damage per second to nearby enemies and Slowing them by @SlowPotency*100@%. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks in this stance deal @PulseDamage@ magic damage to enemies in the storm.

Awaken: Unleash the storm, causing it to follow Udyr's last Attacked enemy, deal an additional @PercentHPBlast@ max Health magic damage over the duration, and Slow by an additional @EmpoweredSlow@.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Storm Stance: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm for @BuffDuration@ seconds, dealing @StormDamage@ magic damage per second to nearby enemies and Slowing them by @SlowPotency*100@%. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks in this stance deal @PulseDamage@ magic damage to enemies in the storm (or enemies around Udyr if the storm expires).

Awaken: Unleash the storm, causing it to follow Udyr's last Attacked enemy, deal an additional @PercentHPBlast@ max Health magic damage over the duration, and Slow by an additional @EmpoweredSlow@.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Storm deals @DamageToMinions_Scaling@ damage to minions. Awakened deals a minimum of @spell.UdyrQ:MonsterNukeMinRCalc@ to monsters.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Awakened Storm Stance</titleLeft><mainText>Udyr's storm is unleashed and deals additional damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Wingborne Storm</titleLeft><mainText>A storm surrounds Udyr, dealing magic damage and slowing units inside.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Mantle Stance</titleLeft><mainText>Udyr's first two attacks in this stance restore health.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him. Recast: Gain an even bigger shield and heal based on max health over the next couple seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Mantle Stance: Udyr gains @TotalShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks gain @LifeSteal*100@% Life Steal and restore @LifeOnHit@ Health.

Awaken: Gain @RecastShield@ Shield, restore @RecastHeal@ Health over @ShieldDuration@ seconds, and Udyr's next two Attacks instead have @LifeSteal*200@% Life Steal and restore @LifeOnHitAwakened@ Health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The Shield granted by an Awaken cast will stack with any remaining Shield from the original cast. Life on hit reduced by @HealOnHitMinionPenalty*100@% against minions.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Iron Mantle</titleLeft><mainText>Udyr is protected by a temporary shield that absorbs incoming damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
